int value_of(string token, int[] registers)
    names := "ABCD"
    match names.find(token)
        nat index
            return registers[index]
        none
            return int(token)
program := [
    "SET A 1", "SET B 1", "SET D 8", "MUL A B", "PRINT A", "ADD B 1", "SUB D 1", "JNZ D -4",
    "SET A 1071", "SET B 462", "SET C A", "MOD C B", "SET A B", "SET B C", "JNZ B -4", "PRINT A",
    "HALT",
]
names := ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
registers := array(4, fill = 0)
pc := 0
executed := 0
while 0 <= pc < int(#program)
    fields := program[pc].split(" ")
    operation := fields[0]
    executed += 1
    if operation == "HALT"
        break
    if operation == "PRINT"
        println(value_of(fields[1], registers))
    elif operation == "JNZ"
        offset := int(fields[2])
        pc += if value_of(fields[1], registers) != 0 then offset else 1
        continue
    else
        index := names.index(fields[1])
        value := value_of(fields[2], registers)
        if operation == "SET"
            registers[index] = value
        elif operation == "ADD"
            registers[index] += value
        elif operation == "SUB"
            registers[index] -= value
        elif operation == "MUL"
            registers[index] *= value
        else
            registers[index] %= value
    pc += 1
println("executed: {executed}")
